scope: RewindBox Pocket skins revised in place a third time (PR #170, precise pressed states on the board packs, merged by the integration session as one merge after the PR #169 revision): four of the seven packs of assets/skins/pocket are rebuilt by RewindBox's own generators (tools/skins/build_pocket_board_originals.py, whose pressed_face the three Originals and Switch Pocket use, and tools/skins/build_switch_pocket.py); none is added or removed and wii-pocket, gamecube-pocket and ps2-pocket are byte-identical. Only the pressed sprites change: the cap settles straight down without shrinking or moving sideways, only the control itself is shaded (_control_part), the well takes the cap's own edge colour, the lip is shifted rather than wrapped, the sprite's crop edge counts as outside; the light pills (Switch Pocket's minus, menu, plus, HOME, Capture, L3 and R3) are pressed in place, their outline fitted on their drawn edge (fit_pill) and antialiased at the sprite's resolution; each frame holds the measured stadium and the fitted shape together, so no touch area shrinks. Bodies, windows, screens, controls at rest, touch areas and items are otherwise unchanged; every pixel comes from the bodies and designs already reviewed (board Originals, PS2 Pocket - Original, Switch Pocket). Console names and marks belong to their owners. No third-party artwork or font bundled. No skin overlay or bridge source changes (the skin orientation workflow lists the PR branch). No hosted package, dependency, framework, engine, Core or vendored native source change.
